narrative.summary: CVE-2023-22515 - Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server broken access control vulnerability. Critical severity, CVSS 9.8 (v3.1). Source: kev.
narrative.affected_summary: One asset is affected: TEL-WIKI-01 (hostname noc-wiki-01, sector telecom, internet-facing, installed version 8.5.1, criticality 3). The version falls within the vulnerable range (>= 8.5.0, < 8.5.2); a fix is available in version 8.5.2.
narrative.exploit_summary: The vulnerability is listed in the CISA KEV catalog (added 2023-10-05) and has an EPSS score of 0.99223 (percentile 0.99935). Public exploit code is reported. Early-warning signals include a new KEV entry and a new public exploit signal detected on 2026-10-31 (simulated). No exploit database entry or GitHub proof-of-concept is recorded.
narrative.why_it_matters: The vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild and is present in our environment, making it a top remediation priority.
recommended_actions: Upgrade TEL-WIKI-01 to Confluence version 8.5.2 or later, or apply the vendor-provided mitigation.
Limit internet exposure of the affected service until the patch is applied.
Review the referenced advisories and any related incident reports before taking action.
